source: BLS 2018 SOC major groups; product-curated exploration templates

automate.title: AI workflow practice
automate.description: Explore operating, supervising or configuring AI for a current-field administrative or information task. Validate applicability before automating; keep physical, regulated and consequential actions under qualified human control.
automate.humanEdge: Select appropriate tools, verify results and retain responsibility for permissions and exceptions.
automate.firstStep: Choose one low-consequence task from your actual work; test an AI-assisted draft using synthetic data and document human checks.

hybrid.title: Human expertise with AI
hybrid.description: Explore keeping judgment, relationships, creativity and hands-on expertise while AI assists with appropriate preparation or documentation within your field.
hybrid.humanEdge: Understand context, communicate with people and make accountable decisions within your competence.
hybrid.firstStep: Separate one actual work task into human responsibilities and optional AI assistance; verify that this division is appropriate.

pivot.title: Career transition research
pivot.description: Research different work using your underlying skills; specific destination roles, entry requirements, transferability and lower exposure are not yet validated.
pivot.humanEdge: Use real work examples to demonstrate underlying skills rather than assuming a job-title match.
pivot.firstStep: List two underlying skills with examples, then research a different role and compare its requirements and exposure evidence.

create.title: Owned offer discovery
create.description: Explore an owned service, practice or product based on domain knowledge. Validate customer demand, professional requirements and permitted scope before delivery.
create.humanEdge: Understand customer problems, earn trust and define accountable delivery boundaries.
create.firstStep: Ask one potential customer about a domain problem, then outline a small owned offer using synthetic examples.
